sources.entry: Medio - A native, lightweight text diff tool with a clean UI and real-time highlighting. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon] ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]](https://github.com/nuance-dev/medio)

summary.one_liner: Medio is a free, native macOS text diff checker that highlights differences in real time as you type.
summary.what_it_does: Medio compares two blocks of text and shows the differences as you type, with no separate compare step. It uses word-level difference highlighting to mark changed portions within lines. The interface is minimal and includes Auto, Dark, and Light modes, with Auto following the system theme and the app icon adapting to appearance. The README says it is built with SwiftUI and AppKit. From v3.0.0 onward, it uses the Differ Swift package for diffing. The README also says the app was used to develop itself.
use_cases: compare two versions of a text document
quick text comparison on a Mac
how_to_run: Download the .app from mediano.vercel.app or the project's releases page.
To build from source, clone the repository (git clone the nuance-dev/medio repo).
Open the project in Xcode and run it (the README does not give explicit build steps).
notable: Real-time diff highlighting that updates as you type
Trinary Auto, Dark, and Light appearance switcher with an appearance-aware icon
Uses the Differ Swift package since v3.0.0
Listed on awesome-mac under Developer Utilities
caveats: The author describes it as a designer's first Swift app and says it is probably buggy.
macOS only, as indicated by its name and description as a native macOS app.
